title: Purchase Orders and Stock Alerts: Reorder Before You Run Out | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Running out of a bestseller costs sales. CrestApps purchase orders keep what you order from suppliers: start a draft from the items that are low on stock, set the costs, mark it ordered, receive part or all of it into a location, or cancel it, while back in stock alerts tell shoppers who asked and low stock alerts tell your staff when to order.

In this video:
• Why purchase orders, and how draft, ordered and received fit together
• Starting a purchase order from low stock
• Costs, quantities and Mark as ordered
• Back in stock alerts: a shopper asks, and how many are waiting
• Receiving part of an order, then everything
• Canceling an order and finding orders by status
• Low stock alerts and who is told
